theater: 蒙法爾科內與喀斯特高原

battle.name: 第七次伊孫佐戰役
battle.theater: 蒙法爾科內與喀斯特高原
battle.brief: 一九一五年九月十八日至十月三日，義大利軍在卡多納指揮下沿伊孫佐河與喀斯特高原發動第七次攻勢，企圖突破奧匈軍縱深堡壘帶、奪取蒙法爾科內。卡面的菲亞特・瑞維利Mod. 1914重機槍正是在此役成建制投入前線，隨步兵連壓制奧軍機槍陣地。

kit.name: 菲亞特·瑞維利重機槍
kit.history: 作為義大利第一款制式氣冷重機槍，與步兵連協同作戰，主要配備於前線火力點，提供持續壓制火力。

countries: 這是義大利王國與奧匈帝國在第一次世界大戰東南戰線的正面較量，時間自一九一五年九月十八日至十月三日，戰線設在伊孫佐河（又譯伊松佐河）中下游與東南面的喀斯特台地之間。義大利方面由陸軍總司令路易吉・卡多納以最高統帥部統一指揮，戰役中以第二、第三集團軍擔任主攻，第四集團軍與山區部隊在北面牽制奧軍；每個步兵師以九個營為骨幹，每營約五百人，師屬砲兵營連同旅團砲兵、工程、醫療與輜重部隊編成一體。奧匈方面，總司令康拉德・馮・赫岑多夫坐鎮維也納兼掌陸軍部，正面交由塞沃扎爾・博雷維奇指揮的伊孫佐集團軍群統一調度，集團軍群下轄第六、第七集團軍以及工兵營與堡壘守備部隊，並得到德國的物質援助與出兵承諾；蒙法爾科內的要塞群與喀斯特各段堡壘線由各工兵單位分段固守，指揮關係相當分散。義軍在數量上佔優，但訓練與火力協調仍在摸索階段；奧軍則以稀疏的縱深梯次堡壘線，抵消化了義軍的人數優勢。
countriesEn: This was the set-piece contest between the Kingdom of Italy and Austria-Hungary on the south-eastern front of the First World War, fought from 18 September to 3 October 1915 between the middle and lower reaches of the Soča (Isonzo) and the karst plateau to its south-east. On the Italian side the Commander-in-Chief Luigi Cadorna directed everything from the Supreme Command: the Second and Third Armies carried the main effort, while the Fourth Army and the mountain troops held down the enemy farther north. Each infantry division was built on nine battalions of roughly five hundred men each, with divisional artillery batteries, corps artillery and engineer, medical and supply units completing the establishment. On the Austro-Hungarian side the commander-in-chief Conrad von Hötzendorf sat in Vienna with the army ministry, while the front itself was handed to Svetozar Boroević and the Isonzo Army Group, which controlled the Sixth and Seventh Armies together with engineer troops and fortress garrisons and drew on German material aid and German promises of intervention; the fortresses of Monfalcone and the various sectors of the Carso were held in detached strongpoints, each with its own garrison and its own chain of command. The Italians were superior in numbers, but their training and fire coordination were still in an improvised state; the Austro-Hungarians met that numerical advantage with a thin network of deep, tiered fortifications.
people: 卡多納是這場攻勢的設計者：他把火力集中於少數幾段陣線，企圖以短時間內的密集砲火加上步兵衝鋒，強行撕開奧軍在喀斯特的縱深堡壘帶；參謀長與各集團軍司令在前方觀察所輪流坐鎮，攻勢的節奏幾乎全憑前線回報臨時決定。博雷維奇是奧軍在伊孫佐正面的實際指揮者，他堅持彈性防禦，讓義軍攻入預設的殲滅地帶，再以反砲擊與預備隊逐次收復失地；蒙法爾科內與卡爾索各堡壘的守備指揮官則在砲火之下維持局部防線，寧可退守也不讓正面被一次打穿。義大利第二集團軍由阿奧斯塔公爵阿方索・迪・薩沃伊亞・阿奧斯塔指揮，第三集團軍一般認為由埃托雷・德・博諾指揮，突擊工兵營與各步兵旅的營連長在塹壕裡直接帶領白刃衝鋒。菲亞特・瑞維利Mod. 1914重機槍的三人乘組（射手、供彈手、瞄準手）是這場戰役裡最不起眼、卻最關鍵的角色之一，他們必須在不到一分鐘內把十發一條的彈帶壓進機匣，又要在砲火停歇的瞬間轉入射擊，否則整條突擊線都會暴露在對方機槍之下。
peopleEn: Cadorna was the author of the offensive. He concentrated the artillery on a few chosen sectors, hoping that a short, massed bombardment followed by infantry assault would tear open the deep fortified belt of the Carso; his staff and the army commanders rotated between forward observation posts, and the rhythm of the attack was decided almost entirely by reports coming back from the front line. Boroević actually commanded the Austro-Hungarian front on the Isonzo. He insisted on a defence in depth, letting the Italians advance into prepared killing ground and then recovering the lost positions with counter-battery fire and reserves, while the commanders of the Monfalcone and Carso fortresses held their local lines under shellfire, giving ground rather than let the front be broken in a single rush. The Italian Second Army was commanded by the Duke of Aosta, Alfonso di Savoia-Aosta, and the Third Army is generally identified as being led by Ettore De Bono; assault engineer battalions and the company and battalion commanders of the infantry led the hand-to-hand charges in the trenches. The three-man crews of the Fiat-Rivelli Mod. 1914 heavy machine gun — gunner, loader and aimer — were among the least conspicuous and most critical figures of the battle, for they had to push a ten-round strip of ammunition into the receiver in less than a minute and then take up firing the moment the guns fell silent, or the whole assault line would lie open under the enemy's machine guns.
kits: 卡面上的菲亞特・瑞維利Mod. 1914是義大利第一款自制制式重機槍，一九一四年由菲亞特公司仿製奧地利施瓦茨洛澤機槍的機匣，改用義大利陸軍制式6.5×54.7公厘卡爾卡諾步槍彈，再改為氣冷結構而定名Mod. 1914。它以十發一條的鋼製彈帶供彈，理論射速每分鐘二百五十至四百五十發，實戰有效射程一千二百至一千六百公尺，連同雪橇式炮架與三腳架全槍約十六公斤，由射手、供彈手與瞄準手三人操作，每個步槍團配發四至六挺，通常置於營的支援分隊或前線火力點，專門壓制對方機槍與步兵射界。一九一五年秋，Mod. 1914在伊孫佐前線第一次成建制投入密集使用，水冷型的Mod. 1915當時尚未普及。與它共用彈種的還有卡爾卡諾M91步槍與卡爾卡諾M91卡賓槍；義軍野戰砲以七五乘二七野戰砲為骨幹，另配一四九乘四二榴彈砲與三七、六三公厘迫擊砲。奧軍則以七・九二公厘施瓦茨洛澤機槍、七五乘五七野戰砲、一二〇公厘榴彈砲，以及二十一與四二〇公厘史考特迫擊砲行反砲擊；兩造都大量使用鐵絲網、混凝土掩體與塹壕內的交通壕，彈藥則靠騾馬與人力沿狹窄海岸公路運上卡爾索。
kitsEn: The Fiat-Rivelli Mod. 1914 on the card face was the first standard heavy machine gun built in Italy. Produced by Fiat in 1914 from the receiver of the Austrian Schwarzlose design and re-chambered for the Italian army's standard 6.5×54.7mm Carcano rifle cartridge, it was converted to an air-cooled layout and named the Mod. 1914. It fed from rigid steel strips of ten rounds, had a theoretical rate of fire of 250 to 450 rounds per minute and a practical effective range of 1,200 to 1,600 metres, and weighed some sixteen kilograms on its sled mount and tripod; it was served by a crew of three — gunner, loader and aimer — and each infantry regiment was issued four to six of them, normally held by the battalion's support section or placed at forward firing points to dominate enemy machine-gun positions and infantry sightlines. In the autumn of 1915 the Mod. 1914 was put into large-scale service on the Isonzo front for the first time, while the water-cooled Mod. 1915 had not yet become common. Sharing its cartridge with it were the Carcano M91 rifle and the Carcano M91 carbine. The Italian field artillery was built around the 75/27 field gun, backed by 149/42 howitzers and by 37mm and 63mm mortars. The Austro-Hungarians answered with the 7.92mm Schwarzlose machine gun, 75/57 field guns, 120mm howitzers, and 210mm and 420mm Skoda mortars used in counter-battery; both sides used barbed wire, concrete shelters and saps inside the trenches on an enormous scale, and ammunition was carried up onto the Carso by mule and by manpower along the narrow coastal road.
tactics: 義軍的打法仍帶著一九一四年開戰初期的痕跡：先以數日乃至一週的準備砲擊逐段推移彈幕，再在拂曉或黃昏集中一次總攻，每次只向前推幾百公尺便停下鞏固。突擊時，突擊工兵營先以工兵器材在鐵絲網上開出通路，步兵以連為單位波浪式推進，制式重機槍分隊隨第一線上陣，用密集的連續射擊蓋住對方機槍陣地與反砲擊砲口。砲火一停，機槍組就成為最脆弱的目標，這也是Mod. 1914在此役打滑、卡殼與被擊毀報告頻仍的原因。奧軍採彈性防禦：前沿不與義軍死拼，節節退到預設的第二、第三道塹壕線，讓義軍先頭部隊深入袋形，再以反砲擊、迫擊砲與預備隊實施短促反擊；工兵在喀斯特石灰岩上挖出的交通壕與地下掩體，使後撤時仍能守住射界。地形上，義軍的補給線極窄，鐵路只能通到蒙法爾科內，砲彈要靠騾馬與人力搬上卡爾索；九月末的連雨與濃霧更令觀察與射向修正極為困難，許多攻勢因此在半途停頓。
tacticsEn: The Italian method still carried the marks of the opening months of 1914. There came several days, even a week, of preparatory bombardment creeping forward segment by segment, then a single general assault concentrated at dawn or dusk that pushed forward only a few hundred metres before the troops dug in. In the assault, engineer battalions opened gaps in the wire, the infantry advanced in company-sized waves, and the machine-gun sections of the battalions went forward with the first line, laying down dense continuous fire against enemy machine-gun positions and the mouths of counter-battery guns. The instant the artillery stopped, the machine-gunners became the most exposed targets on the field, which is why reports of damaged, seized and destroyed Mod. 1914 guns were so frequent in this battle. The Austro-Hungarians fought a defence in depth: they did not lock shields with the Italians at the forward line but gave ground step by step to the prepared second and third trench lines, drawing the Italian leading troops into a pocket and then hitting them with counter-battery fire, mortars and a short counter-attack by reserves. The saps and underground shelters that the engineers cut into the karst limestone let them withdraw without surrendering their firing positions. The Italian supply line was extremely narrow — the railway reached only as far as Monfalcone and shells had to be carried up onto the Carso by mule and by manpower — and the continuous rain and fog of late September made observation and fire correction very difficult, so many attacks stalled halfway.
data: 時間上，此役自一九一五年九月十八日起至十月三日止，前後約十六天，義軍在九月十七日之前已完成數日準備砲擊。兵力方面，義軍在這條正面投入的部隊一般記為二十餘個步兵師，奧軍在伊孫佐正面維持的兵力約八至十個師，人數比常被記為二比一至三比一，砲兵比更達四比一上下。攻擊正面自亞得里亞海岸的西斯特米亞納沿河延伸至卡爾索山麓，長約三十至四十公里；自前線到的里雅斯特尚有二十至三十公里。傷亡方面，義軍損失多據義方戰報記為約五萬五千人，其中陣亡約五千人；奧軍損失則有記為二萬餘人者，亦有統計接近四萬人，差異主要來自戰俘、陣亡與失蹤的計法不同。裝備數字上，Mod. 1914重機槍口徑6.5×54.7公厘，單次供彈十發，每分鐘二百五十至四百五十發，有效射程一千二百至一千六百公尺，全槍約十六公斤，三人操作，每團四至六挺。技術運用上，義軍航空兵在九月下旬曾對蒙法爾科內一線的奧軍陣地投下炸彈，被視為近代第一批以飛機對地面陣地投彈的戰例之一；同一時期義軍在蒙法爾科內方向也首次施放毒氣，有戰史記載為以三十八具發射筒一次齊射。
dataEn: In time, the battle ran from 18 September to 3 October 1915, some sixteen days, after several days of preparatory bombardment that were completed before 17 September. In men, the Italians are generally credited with more than twenty infantry divisions on this front, while the Austro-Hungarians held roughly eight to ten divisions on the Isonzo, a ratio commonly put at two or three to one in infantry and around four to one in artillery. The front attacked stretched from the Austrian Littoral at Sistriana on the Adriatic, along the river and up to the foot of the Carso, some thirty to forty kilometres long, and the firing line lay still twenty to thirty kilometres short of Trieste. In losses, Italian casualties are usually given, on the Italian official figures, as about 55,000, of whom roughly 5,000 were dead; Austro-Hungarian losses are put at over 20,000 by some counts and close to 40,000 by others, the difference coming mainly from how prisoners, dead and missing were tallied. In equipment terms, the Mod. 1914 fired the 6.5×54.7mm cartridge, fed ten rounds at a time, fired 250 to 450 rounds a minute, was effective to between 1,200 and 1,600 metres, weighed about sixteen kilograms and was served by three men, four to six guns to a regiment. In the technical field, Italian airmen dropped bombs on Austro-Hungarian positions near Monfalcone in the last week of September, an action often counted among the first attempts to bomb enemy positions from the air; and in the same period the Italians used poison gas on the Monfalcone sector for the first time, one account describing a single discharge of thirty-eight cylinders.
cause: 義大利在一九一五年五月二十三日依倫敦條約與英法結盟，加入對奧匈的戰爭；直接動機是自一八六六年普魯士戰敗後便始終未收復的領土訴求——北部的特倫托與南蒂羅爾、的里雅斯特與阜姆、以及達爾馬提亞的海岸爭端——加上國內民族主義者對「一八六六年未竟之勝利」的高漲要求。實際的作戰計劃則出自一個更冷靜的計算：一九一五年春俄羅斯戰線開打後，奧匈陸軍主力被釘在東線，若能沿亞的里雅斯特方向打開缺口，義大利就能以有限的兵力拖住對手，迫使維也納在兩線作戰。卡多納在一九一四年已寫下攻勢構想的備忘錄，主張以持續加壓的消耗戰，磨掉奧軍在伊孫佐的預備隊與彈藥存量；第七次正是這套理論第一次面對已經完全成熟的喀斯特堡壘帶，而同年十月與十一月接續的第八、第九次伊孫佐攻勢，則把這種以火炮與人命換取正面推進的做法推到最高。
causeEn: Italy entered the war against Austria-Hungary on 23 May 1915, bound by the Treaty of London with Britain and France. The immediate motives were the territorial claims Italy had never recovered since its defeat in 1866 — the north of the Trentino and South Tyrol, Trieste and Fiume, and the disputed Dalmatian coast — together with the rising demand at home from nationalists for the 'mutilated victory' of 1866. The operational plan, however, came from a colder calculation. Once the Russian front opened in the spring of 1915, the bulk of the Austro-Hungarian army was pinned in the east; if a wedge could be driven open towards Trieste, Italy could tie down its enemy with a small force and force Vienna to fight on two fronts. Cadorna had already set out his idea of the offensive in a memorandum written in 1914, arguing for a war of continuous pressure that would grind down the Austro-Hungarian reserves and ammunition on the Isonzo. The Seventh of September 1915 was that theory meeting the fully matured fortification belt of the Carso for the first time, and the Eighth and Ninth Isonzo offensives of the following October and November carried the same method of trading artillery and lives for a few hundred metres of ground to its extreme.
impact: 這場戰役本身沒有決定戰局，卻定下了一整條戰線的樣子。第七次之後，奧軍在喀斯特的堡壘帶被證明足以抵擋任何單次攻勢，義大利此後只能改以更密集的砲火與更短的突擊去消耗它，於是伊孫佐成為第一次世界大戰消耗戰的代名詞，一打就是十二場、耗掉兩年光陰，最終在一九一七年十月的卡波雷托慘敗中收場。技術上，這一役同時是義大利陸軍把重機槍、空襲與毒氣三種新手段一起帶上前線的起點：Mod. 1914的成建制使用，讓步兵連第一次擁有可以長時間壓制敵方射界的自帶火力；航空兵對地面陣地的投彈與毒氣齊射，預告了總力戰面貌的改變；攻勢中投入的突擊工兵營與裝甲車小組，也在往後的卡爾索攻防中逐步發展成突擊與裝甲協同的雛形。戰略上，此役證明在沒有制空權、沒有成熟滲透、也沒有縱深打擊手段的條件下，正面消耗戰只能換來有限的地盤與龐大的代價；這個教訓，兩年後由義大利自己付帳。
impactEn: The battle decided nothing in itself, but it set the shape of the whole front. After the Seventh, the Austro-Hungarian fortification belt on the Carso was shown to be able to withstand any single offensive, and the Italians could only grind it down with denser bombardment and shorter assaults. From then on the Isonzo became a byword for attrition in the First World War — twelve battles and two years of war, ending in the ruin of Caporetto in October 1917. Technically the battle was also where the Italian army brought the heavy machine gun, aerial bombardment and poison gas forward together. The organised use of the Mod. 1914 gave the infantry company a weapon of its own that could hold down an enemy field of fire for long stretches; bombing of ground positions from the air and the first gas discharge announced a change in the face of total war; and the assault engineer battalions and small armoured-car groups committed to the offensive began, in the later Carso battles, to develop into the embryo of assault and armoured cooperation. Strategically the battle proved that without air superiority, without mature infiltration and without a means of striking in depth, an offensive of attrition could buy only a little ground at a monstrous price — a lesson Italy itself was made to pay for two years later.
result: 結果有限而明確：義軍在多個地段突破了奧軍的第一道塹壕線，奪取了卡爾索西北、蒙法爾科內以東的聖馬蒂諾山脊等高地（一般記為九月下旬），並把包圍蒙法爾科內的堡壘群往後逼；奧軍沒有崩潰，而是有秩序地退到第二、第三道防線，藉交通壕與反砲擊重新把射界接回來，義軍的攻勢在推進幾百公尺後停住，突破並未形成。卡多納出於自身的政治需要仍把此役宣布為成功，義大利最高統帥部也無意收手：十月八日即發動阿爾熱河方向的新攻勢，十月九日攻入戈里齊亞城，把前線推上戈里齊亞平原，迫使奧軍退到河對岸。整條伊孫佐前線此後再無大規模義大利攻勢，直到一九一六年八月與九月德加與喀斯特兩役才重新發動；而在一九一七年，卡波雷托的潰敗則把這條戰線的終局提前寫下。
resultEn: The outcome was limited but clear. The Italians broke through the Austro-Hungarian forward trench line in several places, took heights such as the Colle di San Martino north-west of the Carso and east of Monfalcone — generally dated to the last week of September — and pushed the ring of fortresses around Monfalcone backwards. The Austro-Hungarian army did not collapse: it withdrew in good order to its second and third defensive lines, regained its fields of fire from its saps and counter-battery fire, and the Italian advance stopped after a few hundred metres, with no breakthrough achieved. Pressed by his own political needs, Cadorna still declared the battle a success, and the Italian High Command had no intention of stopping. On 8 October it launched a new offensive on the Arge sector, entered Gorizia on 9 October, pushed the line out onto the Gorizia plain and forced the Austro-Hungarians back across the river. No large Italian offensive followed on the Isonzo front for the rest of 1915 and the first half of 1916, until the battles of Gorizia and the Carso in August and September 1916; in 1917 the collapse at Caporetto wrote the final chapter of this front.
